message.content:
(1) **Image 2** shows stronger, more realistic stone and ground relief. The textures in the second image have much more pronounced depth, with the individual bricks on the walls and the texture of the ground appearing significantly more three-dimensional compared to the flatter look of Image 1.

(2) **Yes**, the Aztec look is preserved. Both images maintain the characteristic muted olive green for the ground and the mossy, weathered appearance of the stone walls. The color palette remains consistent with the original de_aztec aesthetic.

(3) **Yes**, there are rendering artifacts in Image 2. Most notably, several of the large stone blocks/statues on the left side of the screen appear as solid, flat **dark green** (almost black) shapes, indicating missing or incorrectly applied textures. There is also a visible **white horizontal line** (likely a lighting or geometry glitch) stretching across the middle of the scene near the back wall.
